checks.note: Final ecf/c275 heads. Inclusive instrumented samples are retained separately but are not the p95 acceptance measurement. Replay removes all QA wrappers, warms each actual in-memory input 10 times and measures 50 calls/input. No environment values serialized.

capture_dates: Actual UTC capture stamps are preserved; do not relabel October 31 runs as November 1 runs.
normalization: Item graph resolved recursively: duplicate IDs, missing non-root parents and cycles are rejected.
UUIDs/clocks normalized only as documented. Server auto uniqueId normalized only with wire proof client omitted it.
Attachment proof includes normalized owner path + filename + MIME + bytes + SHA256, joined via logId -> itemId and captured wire.
Only Decision 8 six 1.x missing baseline attachments use baseline submitted wire plus complete candidate API download. Unchanged raw-NUL user-log loss is not marked recovered.
Terminal comparisons retain raw stdout and strict timestamp-only result; semantic comparison additionally excludes Cucumber's generated final scenario/step/stopwatch footer.
F04 frozen 62-frame input is historical input replay, not current natural stack generation. Non-Exception/no-project/getter-fault controls are explicitly adapted inputs.
input_reference_note: captured_source plus selection identifies the exact retained raw inputs; SHA256 and native IDs disambiguate them. Controlled argument values are also recorded inline where supplied. No raw input is reconstructed from candidate output.
check_index_note: Every check's full inputs, expected/actual values, verdict and source/Launch/item/log references occur once in checks. Criteria reference them through check_ids; no assertion values were discarded.
